faq.q: What information is needed for a titanium plate or sheet quotation?
faq.a: Provide the grade, governing specification and revision, condition, thickness, width, length, quantity, surface requirement, cutting or processing scope, inspection documents, packing and destination. Add the drawing where cut blanks or tight tolerances are involved.

faq.q: What is the difference between titanium sheet, plate and foil?
faq.a: The terms describe flat products of different thickness ranges. The boundary can vary by specification and market practice. For purchasing, state the exact thickness, dimensions, grade, condition and governing specification rather than relying on the name alone.

faq.q: Which grades can be reviewed for titanium plate and sheet?
faq.a: Common enquiries include Grades 2, 5, 7 and 23. Other grades may be reviewed. Availability, dimensions, condition and the applicable standard must be confirmed for the specific order.

faq.q: Can plate or sheet be supplied as cut blanks?
faq.a: Cut-to-size blanks can be reviewed against the grade, thickness, geometry, tolerance, edge condition, machining allowance and quantity. The accepted process and final scope are stated in the quotation.

faq.q: Are MTC, traceability and additional inspection included automatically?
faq.a: No. Required certificates, traceability level, dimensional records, testing and third-party inspection should be listed before quotation. The confirmed document and inspection package becomes part of the order basis.

faq.q: Are stock, MOQ and lead time fixed?
faq.a: No. They depend on grade, standard, condition, dimensions, quantity, processing, inspection and current material availability. Treat them as quotation-specific values.

faq.q: What information is needed for a titanium tube or pipe quotation?

faq.q: How do ASTM B338, B861 and B862 differ for titanium tube and pipe?
faq.a: B338 covers seamless and welded tubes intended for condenser and heat-exchanger service; B861 covers seamless titanium pipe; B862 covers welded titanium pipe. State the required revision and supplementary requirements in the order.

faq.q: Can HELE supply both seamless and welded products?
faq.a: Yes. Seamless tube and pipe are produced by hot extrusion and welded tube and pipe by TIG welding, both in our own factory. Sizes, grades, condition, testing scope and lead time are confirmed per order.

faq.q: How is the pressure rating of titanium tube or pipe determined?
faq.a: It cannot be determined from the material name alone. The responsible designer must apply the governing design code using dimensions, material properties at design temperature, joint factors, allowances, service conditions and system details.

faq.q: Are hydrostatic, pneumatic, eddy-current, ultrasonic or third-party tests included automatically?
faq.a: No. Applicable tests, sampling, acceptance criteria, witness points and reports depend on the product specification and purchase order. They must be agreed before quotation and order release.

faq.q: What about the titanium clad copper product line?
faq.a: Refer to our dedicated titanium-clad copper product page for bar, rod, tube, busbar and connector supply scope.
